sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that Tribunal has determined permanent disability of 30% but it has not awarded any amount for permanent disability.
It is urged that appellant has remained hospitalized for about 96 days but Tribunal has awarded medical expenses for 60 days.
Further, it is also urged that only Rs 50,000/- has been awarded for pain and suffering and Rs.20000/- for nourishing- diet etc.
On above grounds, it is urged that suitable compensation be awarded.
4. Learned counsel for the respondents submits that just and proper compensation is awarded to the appellants and no enhancement is required in the case.
Therefore, appeal filed by the appellants be dismissed.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

6. So far as permanent disability is concerned, it is correct that Tribunal has determined 30% PDC and in para 19 of the impugned award, it has not awarded any amount for loss of future earning capacity.
Admittedly, appellant is working as a Teacher.
There is nothing on record that on account of permanent disability suffered by appellant, services of the appellant is terminated or he has suffered any loss or he has not been given any promotion.
In view of the above, no amount for loss of earning capacity can be awarded.

7. So far as loss of disability /loss of amenities is concerned, in view of percentage of permanent disability, as well as nature of disability, in this Court's opinion, appellant is entitled to receive Rs.1,50,000/- for loss of amenities.

8. So far compensation awarded under the head of pain and suffering/attendant charges, nourishing diet etc. and loss of earning capacity is concerned, perusal of para 27 to 32 of the award reveals that Tribunal has awarded appropriate amount for above heads and no enhancement is required in the same.
9. Hence, in view of above, appeal filed by the appellant is partly allowed and compensation is enhanced by Rs.1,50,000/- over and above awarded by the Tribunal.
10. Enhanced amount of compensation shall carry interest at the rate determined by the Tribunal.
Other findings recorded by the Tribunal shall remain intact.

11. Appellant shall deposit the defecit court fees within a month and only after depositing the same,
the appellant shall be entitled to receive the enhanced compensation amount.
12. With the aforesaid observations, this appeal is disposed off.
